test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Five people, I, J, K, L, and M, are sitting in a straight row, facing north. K sits to the immediate right of L. Only two people sit between L and I. M sits to the immediate right of I and to the immediate left of J. Who sits in the middle of the row?
solution:
**Given : Five people, I, J, K, L, and M, are sitting in a straight row, facing north. **

**Explanation :**

1) M sits to the immediate right of I and to the immediate left of J.

There are three possible cases for the position of M, I and J.

 
• Case - (1)

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6417fd7b9a4a195d619126193738bc8def5fb5c08341d1d63180bba6cd0f9723.png] 

 
• Case - (2)

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fffcf74cabca1cadd6c934b14372ceafbe3408ca853d65204de1490e46fa47ce.png] 

 
• Case - (3)

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fba7b0ab28a163acc6ae36e2cede4d22536af93fbb5b2cc76ee0d5af3991dbbb.png] 

2) Only two people sit between L and I.

As only two people sit between L and I, therefore there is no possible position for L in case - (3). Thus case - (3) is eliminated.

After positioning L, only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e K.

 
• Case - (1)

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea4ca7adf5633f119b43069c7141faf2c3e2b3c57d0ca1354f437f6cd9526d4c.png] ​​​

 
• Case - (2)

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86506bc739d0cebd45bde0eb22425979e1770c45df600e5361249174e5f8eec0.png] 

3) K sits to the immediate right of L.

As in case - (3) K doesn't sits to the immediate right of L, therefore this case is eliminated.

 
• Case - (1)

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c2f1d4494e3e1ac395d055a9cda178793f92afd329e14b1f1575ef8d93f5f53.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement J in the middle of the row.

Hence, **"J"** is the correct answer.
